source: Exported by run.py from the scored run in this folder. p_fit is the judge's P(fits). overlap is the keyword baseline. Nothing in this file is filled in by hand.

combo.rule: On a decision score, use the keyword score when it is below 0.25 or at least 0.75. Use the judge score on the unsure band in between.
